feeds.title: Flour On My Face Blog
feeds.description: A food blog sharing easy family recipes that anyone can cook including crock pot recipes, chicken recipes, holiday recipes and kid friendly recipes. Arlene has been cooking for her family for over 30 years and she loves sharing easy and delicious recipes with her readers.

feeds.title: Fatgirl Hedonist
feeds.description: Browse hundreds of delicious family-friendly recipes for every occasion with a Latin twist! Then, stick around for giveaways and the 'occasional' restaurant review. My name is Cari Garcia and I'm a proud Latina and the daughter of immigrants.

feeds.title: The Girl Who Ate Everything
feeds.description: Browse over one thousand incredible easy-to-make family recipes that are big on flavor but short on prep time! Spend more time with your family, less time in the kitchen.

feeds.title: The Kitchen Prep Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I am Dianna Muscari and i believe cooking doesn't have to be complicated to be good, that's why I love creating easy recipes with a fresh twist that are as fun to make as they are to eat! Whether you're looking for easy weeknight dinners, simple appetizers that impress or fresh, seasonal recipes, The Kitchen Prep has hundreds of produce-packed options that you'll love. I'm so glad to have you here and can't wait to hear which recipes become your favorites!

feeds.title: Tasty Chomps
feeds.description: Tasty Chomps is dedicated to finding the tastiest bits and pieces in Orlando as well as chronicling the latest foodie happenings and reviews. Founded by Ricky Ly, Tasty Chomps is a food and restaurant blog finding culinary adventures throughout Central Florida and around the world.

feeds.title: Cooking in The Keys
feeds.description: Healthy Gluten-Free Recipes. Explore a collection of delicious and easy gluten-free recipes, including lots of fresh seafood from Key West, Florida. Cooking in The Keys is a top food blog for healthy gluten-free recipes the whole family will love, keeping it fun and tasty.

feeds.title: Eater Miami
feeds.description: The Miami Restaurant, Bar, and Nightlife magazine. Food news and dining guides for Miami. Check out the neighborhoods to know what you can find in various places or search our map for the best restaurants right where you are. You can also get to know about the latest new openings in the city with Eater Miami.

feeds.title: A Sassy Spoon
feeds.description: Browse hundreds of approachable comfort food recipes, Latin staples, and sweet treats made with fresh ingredients. Easy recipes for the home cook! Born and raised in South Florida from Cuban parents , she is a self-taught cook who loved watching her Mami (mom) cook for the whole family as a kid.

feeds.title: Carlos Eats
feeds.description: Carlos Eats is an award-winning blog that provide high quality food content including articles, reviews, etc. Run by Carlos Hernandez, an alumni of the University of South Florida in Tampa, Florida. It began in 2010 as a local food review blog.

feeds.title: MiamiCurated » Food
feeds.description: Find out about the best Food in Miami! New restaurants, best dishes, deals, food festivals and gastronomic events.

feeds.title: Jeff Eats
feeds.description: My name is Jeff. I was born (1949) and bred in Brooklyn, New York. Since 1991, I have lived full-time in South Florida. As this site continues to develop, I will tell you about some of my all-time favorites and introduce you to new and exciting joints as I find them. I have lived full-time in South Florida and have eaten in so many restaurants (down here), that I now consider myself to be a FOOD EXPERT.

feeds.title: Eats by the Beach
feeds.description: Covers quick and easy homestyle meals and recipes made in Millie's little kitchen on the beach. From comfort food to chic international recipes, they make it all.

feeds.title: Miami Food Pug
feeds.description: Miami Food Pug is a Miami food blog that combines local South Florida fare and cute pugs.

feeds.title: Lemon Hearted
feeds.description: Lemonhearted is one of Orlando's top lifestyle and food blogs covering local restaurants, local makers, travel guides, small business interviews, and life in the City Beautiful. Linz started LemonHearted back in 2013 as a way to get more connected to Orlando as it began to thrive. She wanted to focus on supporting the local businesses that were redefining the city.

feeds.title: The Little Kitchen
feeds.description: The Little Kitchen shares quick and easy recipes that are great for every day! It is a food blog started by Julie Tran Deily in 2009. Born in Southern California and have lived most of her life in Central Florida, Julie is a child of Vietnamese immigrants, and a first generation Vietnamese-American.

feeds.title: The Hungry Black Man Blog
feeds.description: A food platform dedicated to the Black and minority culinary ecosystem and all that comes with it!

feeds.title: The Food Stories Project Blog
feeds.description: Recipes and Stories From Ashley's Florida Kitchen. The blog focuses on Recipes, Food Stories (related to the south/specifically Florida), Local food and product use and recipes, Florida foodways, Farmer advocacy, places in Florida with food memories.

feeds.title: Yummy House Blog
feeds.description: The focus of this onsite blog is the Orlando menu offered by the best Asian restaurants in the city of Florida, U.S.A.

feeds.title: The Chowfather
feeds.description: I'm a food fan not a critic. I love great food and love sharing great spots even more.

feeds.title: Join Me in Miami » Food+ Drinks
feeds.description: Hi! Welcome to the online diary of my love for fashion, food, travel, & life in Miami.

feeds.title: Florida Girl Food
feeds.description: This is a blog where I cook according to my mood. My style is for the 'Florida Girl.' You won't see too many stews, roasts, or soups, because it's HOT where we live! The majority of my recipes are health conscious, because I can't afford to pack on the pounds while living the beach life in sunny South Florida! All of these recipes are tried and true! Some are original, some are family recipes, and some are adapted.

feeds.title: Burger Beast
feeds.description: Burger Beast writes a food blog about Comfort Food based out of Miami, Florida. He is also an Event Creator, Food Historian & the Burger Museum's Curator.

feeds.title: Authentic Florida » Eat. Shop. Stay
feeds.description: Articles on food, shopping and unique places to stay. Authentic Florida's mission is to enhance one's appreciation of Florida through travel and lifestyle tips, and to encourage their readers to explore the hidden treasures of the Sunshine State.

feeds.title: West Palm Beach Food Tours Blog
feeds.description: West Palm Beach Food Tours offers food tours in Palm Beach, FL, including downtown and historic neighborhoods, as well as cooking classes.

feeds.title: Scott Joseph Orlando Restaurant Guide
feeds.description: An online source for restaurant news and reviews from Scott Joseph, the most trusted critic in Central Florida.

feeds.title: Miami New Times » Food & Drink
feeds.description: Discover new restaurants and where to find the best food in Miami. Some of the city's finest food writers cover the restaurant industry for Miami New Times, reporting on openings and closings, reviewing restaurants, interviewing chefs, and recommending the best food and drink.
